key_insight: Direct element-level inversion of non-diagonal mass matrices offers a path to richer inertial representation in explicit finite element dynamics.
engineering_relevance: The approach could support higher-order solid elements without requiring a global mass-matrix solve at each explicit time step.
method: Develop a systematic inversion method for solid isoparametric element mass matrices of arbitrary interpolation order.
Blend lumped and consistent mass matrices using a weighting parameter.
Derive an explicit inverse formula for the eight-node hexahedral element.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an analytical eight-node hexahedral demonstration, but no quantitative accuracy, stability, or runtime benchmarks.
watch_item: Element-level inverses do not automatically yield the inverse of the assembled global mass matrix; integration into an explicit solver requires care.
